title: Link tasks to roadmap vectors and report roadmap coverage
goal: Tasks and roadmap vectors (.agents/roadmap.json VC-*) are separate backlogs. Add an optional 'roadmap' field to tasks (validated against roadmap.json), '--roadmap VC-...' on 'susi tasks add', and 'susi tasks roadmap [--uncovered]' reporting per vector its priority, linked open/closed tasks and whether it is uncovered, with totals by priority. Tests roadmap_link_* (validation, coverage maths, unknown vector rejected).
